analysis:
The supplied changes are CI, Makefile, changelog and test edits. I found no runtime security regression in them.

.github/workflows/integration.yml:
- The exact-cache lane (head lines 290-291) now pins DARKBLOOM_CBV2_KV_QUANTIZATION and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_CHECKPOINT_QUANTIZATION to native.
- The smoke lane (head lines 320-352) now expects backend "auto" and fails if the KV or checkpoint quantization env vars are set. It no longer asserts contiguous.
- Action pins, secrets handling and the split between push-time HF_TOKEN and unauthenticated PR downloads are unchanged. No new secrets, permissions or triggers were added.

Makefile:
- Adds test-only invocations: scripts/test-stage-swiftpm-resource-bundles.py, scripts/benchmarks/test_radix_forward_shapes.py, and two reports/runtime-kv-path-2026-10-09/qualification tests.
- Nothing is fetched or executed with elevated privileges.

changelog.d/native-inference-quantized-checkpoints.md describes provider behaviour changes that are not in the supplied source:
- balanced encrypted-checkpoint storage requested by default;
- distinct layout/profile identities;
- bounded CPU conversion of older checkpoint rows.
These touch T-041 and TB-007: the SSD prefix-cache at-rest format, DBK3 metadata/AAD, HMAC lookup tags, and the 30-minute TTL.

The next pass should check these points in the provider source, which was not supplied:
- New layout/profile identifiers must not add prompt-derived plaintext to the AAD or metadata beyond the keyed lookupTag (a T-041 detection_hint item).
- Old-format rows must be authenticated before conversion.
- Cache scope/salt folding and the TTL must be unchanged.
- The conversion must stay bounded in CPU and memory.

coordinator/tests/api/billing/payouts/global_payouts_queue_test.go adds coverage for payout dispatch idempotency: a later worker only reconciles and does not resubmit a payment. This is a test-only change that supports the T-060 and TB-008 posture.

Coverage limit: no provider or coordinator source was in this batch, so the changelog claims are unverified.
